sources.snippet: CARDIAC-FM is a multimodal foundation model for cardiovascular risk prediction using 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) and cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) data.

sources.title: CARDIAC-FM: A Multimodal Foundation Model for Cardiovascular Risk ...
sources.snippet: Atrial fibrillation and heart failure impose substantial health burdens worldwide, yet existing prediction models lack sufficient accuracy and generalizability. We developed CARDIAC-FM, a multimodal foundation model that learns joint representations of 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) and cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) through contrastive learning. sources.title: CARDIAC-FM: A Multimodal Foundation Model for Cardiovascular Risk ...
sources.snippet: CARDIAC-FM consistently outperformed unimodal models across all cohorts, and jointly incorporating ECG features with established clinical risk scores yielded additive gains in discrimination, indicating that ECG and traditional risk factors capture complementary dimensions of cardiovascular risk.
